name: Caverns of Time
summary: In the Caverns of Time, Nozdormu and the bronze dragonflight guard Azeroth's fragile timeways. Deep in Tanaris's eastern cliffs, they watch for mortal intrusion and changes to time's flow.

sections.title: The Winding Timeways
sections.body:
Deep beneath Tanaris's eastern cliffs, the Caverns of Time gather the currents of history. At the dawn of the world, the titans charged Nozdormu the Timeless One and his bronze dragonflight with guarding these winding corridors.

Time moves strangely within them, and hidden rifts show glimpses of the past and future. Relics from distant eras lie scattered across the sands. Anachronos watches near the entrance while lesser bronze drakes patrol the descent and guard the one true timeline.

sections.title: A Hoard of Eras
sections.body: The Caverns of Time also hold a vault where past and future meet. Over millennia, the bronze flight has gathered fragments of Azeroth's history: ancient dwarven structures, a watchtower from Lordaeron, chieftain quarters from the orcish clans, and armor from the first kings of Stromgarde. Some travelers have slipped past the sentinels to see these wonders. The inner gateways stay shut until the flight decides mortal intervention is needed.

faq.q: Can I go inside the Caverns of Time right now?
aliases: can i enter caverns of time
how to enter caverns of time
faq.answer: No. The way into the Caverns of Time remains sealed, and the bronze dragonflight admits no mortals. Anachronos is indifferent to travelers, but his companions patrol the entrance and attack mortals who stray too close.

faq.q: Who rules over the Caverns of Time?
aliases: who lives in caverns of time
faq.answer: Nozdormu the Timeless One rules the Caverns of Time. The titans empowered him to oversee time, and he entrusts their daily stewardship and the entrance guard to his prime scion, Anachronos, and the bronze dragonflight's guardians.

faq.q: Why are there random buildings and artifacts inside?
aliases: why are there human towers in caverns of time
faq.answer: Nozdormu spent ages collecting and cataloging physical relics from across Azeroth's history. The caverns hold misplaced treasures, including a Lordaeron guard tower, dwarven architecture, orcish structures, and weapons from long-forgotten mortal kingdoms.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the bronze dragonflight here?
aliases: what do bronze dragons do here
faq.answer: The titans charged the bronze dragonflight with guarding time's flow and history's integrity. Its guardians prevent mortal tampering and outside disruptions from unraveling the events that define the world.

angles.text: The temporal magic in the Caverns of Time far exceeds mortal chronomancy. As a Mage, you can glimpse forces beyond arcane manipulation.
As a Night Elf, you remember the kaldorei's ancient pacts with the Dragon Aspects. Nozdormu's charge is essential to preserving the world's survival.
